keyframe_review.note: Cliopatria's shape (2,252 km2, 8 cells; bbox 8.17 W-7.45 W, 37.00-37.45 N) lies wholly in Portugal on the eastern Algarve around Faro (four of its eight cells within 30 km of Faro), where the page puts nothing: it says Tejada is 'located in the present day Province of Huelva in southern Spain'. It also runs a year past the page's end, 'conquered by the Almohad Caliphate: 1150'. No infobox area exists to compare (the page gives none).

notes: Cliopatria's Taifa of Tejada shape is displaced: it lies on the eastern Algarve (Portugal) around Faro, while the page puts the taifa at Tejada in the Province of Huelva (the village site is near Escacena del Campo, about 30 km west of Seville; the circle's centre is the researcher's approximate reading, no page opened gives coordinates). The correction is a 27 km circle of Cliopatria's area, as the Carmona dossier did for its displaced shape; it overlaps the Niebla dossier's 18 km circle by a little (Yusuf al-Bitruyi ruled both). The pages disagree on the start (1146 on the Tejada page, 1145 on the Taifa overview) and the Tejada page's ruler list has a typo ('Niebla 1145-1450'). The infobox 'Preceded by: Taifa of Silves' is not explained on any page; the Cliopatria Almoravid shape is the stated predecessor. Page budget 1-2: four pages were opened, two of them thin (Almoravid, Almohad). Counterpart almohad-caliphate (af-02) should carry the matching gain.
